changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO user_profile (id, jhi_user_id, role, active, company_id) SELECT nextval('sequence_generator'), u.login, 'EMPLOYE', u.activated, e.company_id FROM pz_user u INNER JOIN employee e ON lower(e.professional_email) = lower(u.email) WHERE e.user_profile_id IS NULL AND e.professional_email IS NOT NULL AND e.professional_email <> '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_profile up WHERE up.jhi_user_id = u.login );

UPDATE employee e SET user_profile_id = up.id FROM user_profile up JOIN pz_user u ON u.login = up.jhi_user_id WHERE lower(e.professional_email) = lower(u.email) AND e.user_profile_id IS NULL AND e.professional_email IS NOT NULL AND e.professional_email <> '';
